verdict.rationale: Kimi is a consumer AI assistant, so a setting that lets users opt out of having their conversations used for training is a fair thing to ask about. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions such a setting, a data-usage policy, or any privacy toggle. The documentation covers Kimi Code tooling, the API platform and help topics, and the community items discuss pricing, model quality and censorship, none of which address training-data use.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can control whether my conversations are used to train models
